Input: A single integer N read from standard input, representing the upper bound for the sum of x, y, and z.
Output: Prints each triple (x, y, z) in lexicographical order to standard output, formatted as "(x, y, z)".
Behavior:
  1. Place the import statement for the Scanner class at the top of the file, outside any method definitions.
  2. Initialize a Scanner object to read input from the standard input stream.
  3. Read an integer N from the input using the Scanner object.
  4. Iterate over integer x from 0 to N inclusive.
  5. For each x, iterate over integer y from 0 to N - x inclusive.
  6. For each y, iterate over integer z from 0 to N - x - y inclusive.
  7. Print the triple (x, y, z) in the format "(x, y, z)".
  8. Continue the iteration until all combinations are processed.
  9. End of the main function.
